name: Hanging Knee Raise
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar and hang with your arms extended and your legs straight down.
Brace your core and raise your knees toward your chest, curling your pelvis up at the top.
Lower your legs back down slowly without swinging.
Keep the movement controlled and avoid using momentum.
image_prompt_scene: Hanging from a pull-up bar by both hands with the arms fully extended, feet clearly off the floor, legs straight down.
